text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Organisation of African Unity (OAU) Council of Ministers meeting opens in Harare on Wednesday to adopt the agenda of the 33rd OAU assembly of heads of state and government starting next week.
- The OAU and United Nations special envoy to the great lakes region, Mohammed Sahnoun, arrived in Harare on Monday to report to the OAU summit on the situation in the troubled region.
- Zimbabwe and the OAU have condemned the dethroning of Sierra Leone's President Ahmad Tejan Kabbah in a military coup on Sunday.
- At least 5,000 soldiers have so far been retrenched from the Zimbabwe National Army in an exercise meant to reduce the 40,000 strong army by 25 percent.
